title: Eww Brother Eww
blurb: "Ewww, brother! Ewww!" The horrified nasal shriek from one of TikTok's most-replayed animated shorts, in which one sibling reacts to another with rapidly escalating disgust. It works because the delivery is so wildly disproportionate to anything actually happening on screen. The clip spread across Shorts, Reels and Roblox edits within weeks of appearing. Play it when somebody tells you, unprompted and in considerable detail, exactly what they had for lunch. Disgust, fully committed, no notes.
origin: A line from a viral TikTok animated short about two brothers.
